document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You read the following: “Where is the Lost City of the Old 
Ones? Where are the treasures of the Eldritch Masters? Cursed 
are they, condemned by the shoggoths to lie buried, waiting in 
the ice, for one more turn of Aten’s Top.”
Add +1 percentile to your Cthuthu Mythos skill and subtract 1 
Sanity point. With a successful Language (Hieroglyphics) roll, go 
to 157. Fail the roll and either continue looking over the books, 
go to 41; or, return to the New York Public Library, go to 74.
(41)
